name: Suzy
source:
On a lonely Halloween night, you're approached by a pretty girl you've seen at school. She invites you over to watch a scary movie, but things get a lot scarier than you thought!

[From [url=https://ajtoons.itch.io/suzy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在孤单寂寥的万圣节之夜，一位你在学校里见过的漂亮女生主动向你搭话。她邀请你去她家一起看恐怖电影，然而事情的发展却比你想象中恐怖得多！

[摘自[url=https://ajtoons.itch.io/suzy]itch.io[/url]]
